title: The Oversold Event
description: Concurrent seat holds oversell events, mobile retries duplicate bookings, and expiry workers release inventory twice.
objective: Reproduce the reported failures and repair the implementation without changing its public interfaces.
expectedBehavior: Use the provided SQLite Database. reserve_seats returns a reservation dict; exactly the available number of concurrent requests may succeed, with SoldOut otherwise. Hold expiry is now+600 seconds. Positive integer quantities and nonempty keys are required. Replaying a key with identical event/user/qty returns the same reservation; conflicting reuse raises ValueError. Inventory decrement and reservation insertion must be one database transaction with rollback on failure. expire_holds releases held reservations at expires_at <= now exactly once, even with concurrent workers. Do not replace database transactions with process-local locks.
constraints: Use only the language standard library; no network access or external packages.
The provided tests are read-only; additional private tests verify edge cases.
